verdict.rationale: Grok is itself the assistant, and users can delegate tasks to it. The docs describe agentic coding via Grok Build on the API and CLI, multi-agent research orchestration, and server-side agentic tools (web search, code execution, attachment search) that turn a request into an agentic workflow; a hands-on user calls the Grok Build CLI "very good" (grok-comm-11). Missing for 10: an assistant embedded in the platform's own console or UI, documentation of the delegation and task-handoff experience beyond capability statements, and stronger independent corroboration of task completion reliability (one user reports Grok ending tasks prematurely and claiming "Done!").
